description:
Coffee brewing assistant with timer, bean management, and tasting notes

Brew Guide is an all-in-one coffee brewing assistant app.
Features include brewing timer with multi-stage guidance, coffee bean inventory management,
brewing notes with ratings and flavor profiles, and cloud sync support.
- Add the 2026 coffee year in review, available from December 1.
- Adjust grinder settings with the dial and save changes on exit.
- Back up local data before restoring a backup and show progress during the first Supabase sync.
- Fix interrupted WebDAV sync and false conflicts when saving brewing notes.
